notes.title: Good News for AMD Graphics Card Users 🎉
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We finally have good news for AMD users!
[/p][p]As we reported earlier, AMD driver update 25.8.1 introduced a serious issue that caused invisible or flashing textures and made Loan Shark unplayable for many of you.[/p][p][/p][p]The fix is now live. AMD has released driver [b]25.9.2[/b], which resolves the rendering problems not only in Loan Shark, but also in many other Godot-based games.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629405/fea623ebf2770227b05f281b407c5e2ccbd163d5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ Please note: this update is not yet available through auto-update. You’ll need to download and install it manually from AMD’s official page: [url="https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/release-notes/RN-RAD-WIN-25-9-2.html"]https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/release-notes/RN-RAD-WIN-25-9-2.html[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Once updated, Loan Shark should run smoothly again.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your patience and for sticking with us through this hiccup. We’ll keep monitoring things in case of further issues, but for now, enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p]Nicola
Studio Carota[/p]

notes.title: The Anti-Markiplier Fix
notes.content: [p]Hi folks! This patch fixes a small bug where the loan shark's timer would reset to 45 Minutes whenever it ran out, allowing people to "get to port" using the boat and waiting, something that should be impossible.[/p][p][/p][p]Some poeple previously reported this issue and it also happened in the latest video from Markiplier :p [/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="YQVkrsSrCkU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We found the fix a couple of days ago and planned to release it with some other content, but I'm releasing it immediately seeing how common it might've become.  Also, we are working on new endings and might add some "special" ones just in case you manage to break it.  Thank you all![/p]

notes.title: Fixed game breaking bug preventing you from fishing!
notes.content: A game breaking bug preventing you from catching any fish was introduced with the latest update. This patch fixes that issue!

notes.title: Camera jittering fix.
notes.content: Hi folks! This update tries to fix some issues people have been encountering where the underwater camera jitters uncontrollably. We hope this will make the game more enjoyable!

notes.title: 10,800 copies in 6 days?!
notes.content:
[p]When we released [i]Loan Shark[/i], we thought it would be a small, quiet launch, just a fun way to learn how to publish our first game on Steam. We had no budget, no publisher, and only 3 months to make it. Honestly, we didn’t expect much.[/p][p]But here we are, six days later, with over [b]10,800 copies sold[/b] and a ton of amazing messages, reviews, and videos from all of you. I mean, the game is in the Top Sellers tab here on Steam![/p][p] We can’t even explain how much this means to us.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]What’s next?[/b][/h2][p]Your feedback has been incredible, and we’re putting it to good use in two ways:[/p][p][/p][p][b]A patch for Loan Shark[/b] We’re working on fixing some of the most common issues you’ve mentioned, like the boat timer running out but the boat not arriving to port, the janky knife, the spinning camera, and more. I’m holding off on releasing it right away because I want to bundle a bunch of fixes together at once, to minimize the chance of breaking something else in the process.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Making the next game even better[/b]
Every bit of feedback about [i]Loan Shark[/i] is going straight into our next project, like how much everyone seems to desire having multiple endings. We’re keeping what worked, improving what didn’t, and aiming to deliver something even more polished.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you for supporting us. You’ve turned our first little experiment into something unforgettable.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned, both the patch and news about our next game are coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Nicola[/p][p][i]Studio Carota[/i][/p]

notes.title: Fixed some minor rendering bugs
notes.content:
Hi folks! This patch should just fix some rendering bugs some people are having, including the game defaulting to the OpenGL renderer even though the game doesn't support it.

I'm still gathering info on the camera spinning so fast it crashes people's game!

Cheers!

notes.title: Thank You from Studio Carota!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We just wanted to take a moment to say [b]thank you[/b]. Loan Shark is our very first game release, and we honestly had no idea what to expect. Seeing the incredible response from all of you has blown us away:[/p][list][*][p][b]4,600+ copies sold in just 3 days!!!!![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]52 reviews, sitting at [i]Very Positive![/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][p]For a small debut project, this is absolutely beyond anything we imagined. Every time we see someone post a screenshot, share their experience, or leave a review, it means the world to us.[/p][p]We’re reading all your comments, reports, and feedback. While we might take a little time to figure out certain bugs, please know we’re committed to improving the game and making sure your experience is as smooth as possible.[/p][p]Two members of our tiny team are taking a short break for Ferragosto, but I’m staying here in Turin, catching up on everything Loan Shark and preparing bug fixes. And yes, we’re also already working on our next game.[/p][p]Once again, thank you for making our first launch unforgettable. You’ve made this totally worth it.

Nicola
[i]Studio Carota[/i][/p]

notes.title: Fixed main menu issue
notes.content: Some players weren't able to select the main menu options with their mouse. That should be fixed now!

notes.title: 🚨 Important Notice for AMD Graphics Card Users🚨
notes.content:
[h3]TL;DR[/h3][list][*][p][b]Problem[/b]: AMD driver update 25.8.1 breaks Loan Shark[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix[/b]: Roll back to previous AMD driver, or wait for AMD’s next update[/p][/*][*][p][b]Help speed up the fix[/b] by reporting the issue: [url="https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/faqs/AMDBRT.html"]https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/faqs/AMDBRT.html[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]After yesterday's launch, we’ve soon become aware of a serious graphics issue affecting [b]some players using AMD graphics cards[/b]. This issue causes invisible or flashing textures on the main menu and in-game, and even some crashes.[/p][p][b]This is not a bug in Loan Shark itself[/b], but rather a problem introduced in AMD’s [b]latest graphics driver update (version 25.8.1)[/b] that has also broken many other games made with the Godot engine.[/p][p][/p][p]See here:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://forum.godotengine.org/t/graphics-freak-out-on-amd-cards/118661"]https://forum.godotengine.org/t/graphics-freak-out-on-amd-cards/118661[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/109378"]https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/109378[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Possible fixes[/h3][p]Until AMD releases a patch, you have two options:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Roll back to the previous AMD driver version. [/b]This should fix the issue, although it doesn't seem to work for everyone. A quick Google search will bring up guides for rolling back AMD drivers — here’s one example from the community: [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/pcmasterrace/s/Fv4H02FKoC"]https://www.reddit.com/r/pcmasterrace/s/Fv4H02FKoC[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Report the bug directly to AMD. [/b]We're guessing the more reports they get, the faster they’ll fix it: [url="https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/faqs/AMDBRT.html"]https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/faqs/AMDBRT.html[/url][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]We'll keep you posted![/h3][p]As soon as AMD releases an update that resolves the issue, we’ll post another announcement and let you know you can safely update your drivers again and/or buy Loan Shark if you wanted to play it. Be sure to follow to game to receive updates.[/p][p]We're sorry to those of you affected. We’ve tried implementing workarounds on our side, but unfortunately that causes other problems and is too risky to do haphazardly.[/p][p]If you stick with us and apply the fix above, Loan Shark should run exactly as intended. Thank you for your patience and for supporting our game even through hiccups like this.[/p][p]
Nicola
[i]Studio Carota[/i][/p]

notes.title: 2000k wishlists and still rising!
notes.content: [p]Dear fisherpeople.[/p][p][/p][p]We didn't believe we would write this new announcement so close to the previous one about the thousand milestone. Yet here we are, celebrating another major (and unexpected) accomplishment of [i]Loan Shark[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]As many of you may know, one of our TikTok short video went viral a couple of days ago (you can find it [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@studio_carota/video/7531020732617329942"]here[/url]). It generated an incredible boost in visibility, and is probably the main cause behind this incredible spike in popularity.[/p][p][/p][p]The short is still going strong on TikTok and the wishlists are still piling up. We couldn't be happier, really. And a little overwhelmed, too. [/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, the Loan Shark has almost got to the release date. We are really really really really excited about this.I f you want to help us increase momentum, please share the Steam page and wishlist the game, if you haven't.[/p][p][/p][p]Go fish (and wishlist) before it's too late.[/p][p][/p][p]Luca,[/p][p]Studio Carota[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Building Loan Shark
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We just published a new article on our devlog:[/p][p]
[b]📝 "[/b][url="https://open.substack.com/pub/studiocarota/p/using-daily-notes-for-lightweight?r=5tqdfc&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web&showWelcomeOnShare=true"]Using Daily Notes for lightweight, indie-friendly Game Design documentation[/url][b]"[/b][/p][p][/p][p]It's a behind-the-scenes look at how we design [i]Loan Shark[/i] as a two-person team.[/p][p]Instead of using a traditional GDD, we keep our process fast, messy, and effective with [b]daily design notes[/b] in [b]Obsidian.md[/b]. We log playtest results, sketch ideas, track tasks, and document decisions as we go. The system is minimal, async-friendly, and reflects how we [i]actually[/i] work.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://open.substack.com/pub/studiocarota/p/using-daily-notes-for-lightweight?r=5tqdfc&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web&showWelcomeOnShare=true" style="button"]Read it here[/url]
[/p][p]Let us know what you think, and if you’ve got your own hacks for keeping design clear and creative, we’d love to hear them.
[/p][p]Nicola & Luca 🦈[/p]

notes.title: LOAN SHARK REACHES 1000 WISHLISTS
notes.content: [p]Fisherpeople, we made it![/p][p][/p][p]Much to our surprise, we caught a lot of wishlists in our net during the night, and we finally got to 1000 wishlists here on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]This is huge for us, for Studio Carota. [i]Loan Shark[/i] was meant to be a simple experiment to release a game on Steam, but it's turned into so much more. Thank you for everyone who took the time to discover our little game. The release date is close, and we are working on the finishing touches.[/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile, the numbers are still growing, much like your debt to the Loan Shark. If you want to put a patch on that, try the demo and start grinding towards freedom.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826130/Loan_Shark_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Then, you may hit the wishlist button and join your fellow fisherpeople amid the jaws of the Loan Shark![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751730/Loan_Shark/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Go fish and enjoy your day![/p][p]Luca[/p][p]Studio Carota[/p]

notes.title: We have a Discord: come say "hi"!
notes.content: [p]Hello there fisherpeople![/p][h3][/h3][p]We are hitting a small but significant milestone for the growth of our studio: the official Discord server for Studio Carota is open![/p][p][/p][h3]What Discord server?[/h3][p]Actually, it has been open for a couple of months; we simply didn't announce it in grand style. We were a little self-conscious about the server and its appeal, and instead opted to focus on the development of [i]Loan Shark[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Now that [i]Loan Shark[/i] is almost completely finished (Nicola is hunting down the remaining bugs as I'm writing this announcement), we feel it is time to shine some light to the server.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Why a server?[/h3][p][i]"Because every great indie studio has one, duh."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Wait! It was a joke... to a certain degree. It is true that a lot of great indie studios have a Discord server, because Discord is a great way for developers to interact with their community.[/p][p][/p][p]That's our goal, really. We've seen people noticing us and our game. We would love to hear from those people and get to know them better. We would love to get to know [i]you[/i] better. Talking about our games, the games you like, the games we like.[/p][p][/p][p]Discord is not so much a bridge to a community as it is a base to build a community upon. We use it for everyday work, for connecting with friends, for playing online... why not use it also to reach out to you, our players (current and future)?[/p][p][/p][h3]Here's the server![/h3][p]Let us know what you think about this initiative. Maybe on the server?[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/X6Xd4BmMCK"]https://discord.gg/X6Xd4BmMCK[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][p]And if you are in the mood for clicking links, you could also go try the [i]Loan Shark[/i] demo:[/p][p][/p][p]And later you could wishlist the game:[/p][p][/p][p]Happy fishing and thank you for reading![/p][p][/p][p]- Luca[/p][p]Studio Carota[/p]

notes.content: [p]Hello there, fellow fisherpeople![/p][p]Today it's big catch day: the [i]Loan Shark [/i]demo has been downloaded more than [b]1000 times[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629405/ad2a64ceea7207bdd622fecc24306fb212338d8a.gif"][/img][/p][p]We're also going strong with more than [b]400 wishlists[/b] in the bucket already. This huge increase in less than 15 days was due to [i]Loan Shark[/i] participating in the Steam Fishing Fest, the release of the demo and a lot of content creators picking up and playing the demo.[/p][p][/p][p]We know we're still the smallest fish in the pond. And yet, it's motivating, exciting and even a little bit frightening to see how quickly you, the players, have started engaging with our game. Some of you even left reviews on the demo store page![/p][p][/p][p]For all these reasons, we want to thank you from the bottom of our hearts! Expect updates in the following weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy fishing![/p][p]Studio Carota[/p][p][/p][p](And if you haven't played the demo yet...)[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826130/Loan_Shark_Demo/?l=italian"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🦈 Thank You for the Amazing Fishing Fest Week!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We wanted to take a moment to say a big [b]thank you[/b] to all of you who discovered, visited, and wishlisted [i]Loan Shark[/i] during Steam's [b]Fishing Fest[/b]. This was our first-ever Steam event as developers, and the experience gave us a huge boost—not just in visibility, but in confidence.[/p][p]Thanks to your support, [i]Loan Shark[/i] gained [b]228 new wishlists[/b] during the week of the event, pushing us past [b]289 total wishlists[/b]. For a small indie team working on their debut game, that’s [i]huge[/i].[/p][p]We also learned a ton about how Steam works behind the scenes: we experimented with our trailer, tweaked screenshots, and even updated our capsule art multiple times during the event to see what clicked with you.[/p][p]We missed the Fishing Fest Train for the demo, but we’ve been hard at work and we [i]just[/i] released a public demo of [i]Loan Shark[/i]. If you want to try it out, it’s available on our store page now![/p][p]Once again, thank you for helping us grow during the Fishing Fest. It’s been an eye-opening, motivating experience—and we’re already planning how to do things even better next time.[/p][p]If you happen to be interested on our strategy for the fest, we wrote a [url="https://studiocarota.substack.com/p/sharing-our-steam-fishing-fest-wishlist"]newsletter post[/url] that goes more in depth on that stuff.[/p][p]🦈 Wishlist the game if you haven’t yet, and stay tuned—August is just around the corner.[/p][p]– Nicola[/p]

notes.title: Loan Shark - Devlog #1
notes.content: [p]Have you ever felt like you were choking from stress and anxiety while staring at an obstacle you know you cannot overcome?[/p][p][/p][p]That's what [i][b]Loan Shark[/b][/i] is about. You play as a professional angler in debt to the mob. During a night of work on your fishing boat, you catch a weird fish that can talk and offers its help to get you out of debt. The only problem is, help does not come cheap.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]What kind of game is [i]Loan Shark[/i]?[/h2][p]A short, dark psychological horror game about hopelessness, debt, and fishing. The sea is your mind, the boat is yourself, and you cannot go back until you've fished enough.[/p][list][*][p]If you enjoy psychological horror games that deal with adult, contemporary themes like [i][b]Mouthwashing[/b][/i], you will enjoy [i][b]Loan Shark[/b][/i].[/p][/*][*][p]If you appreciate narrative games that merge gameplay and authored storytelling like [i][b]Paratopic[/b][/i], you will appreciate [i][b]Loan Shark[/b][/i].[/p][/*][*][p]If you like [b]short, straight-to-the-point gaming experiences[/b] that you can play in one sitting, [i][b]Loan Shark[/b][/i] is perfect for you.[/p][/*][/list][p]Wishlist the game and follow us if this is something you want to play. We want to hear from you as we get closer to the release date.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751730/Loan_Shark/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Who we are[/h2][p]Hello there! We are [b]Luca[/b] and [b]Nicola[/b], the developers behind [i][b]Loan Shark[/b][/i].[/p][p]A couple of words about us: we are two game developers from Italy with previous experience in the local game industry. We met and became friends while working for a local game studio. Fast forward to October 2024: we had both left that studio and started collaborating together.[/p][p]We released a small demo project for free on itch.io to test our collaboration. Along the way, we joined forces with [b]Rumpelstiltskin[/b], a friend of ours and a talented all-around artist. The three of us are now working hard on our first commercial game to be released here on Steam.[/p][p]That game is, of course, [i][b]Loan Shark[/b][/i].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]What comes next[/h2][p]This post is the first in a series of dev logs focused on sharing the development process behind [i][b]Loan Shark[/b][/i] with the Steam community.[/p][p]As indie developers, what we need to thrive is a community that enjoys our games and supports our work. We believe we have meaningful things to share and that we just need to find our audience.[/p][p]These dev logs are a small step toward that goal! Part dev diary for us to reflect on the process, part desire to share our daily work and progress. We hope you will enjoy them and get to know the game and us a little better.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading![/p][p]Luca and Nicola[/p]
